quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found just below your neck, running side to side?
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: You can feel it under your skin, side to side.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: It is the most commonly broken bone in the human body.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found wherever two bones meet and move together?
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: Your elbows and knees are examples of these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: Without joints, your body would be completely stiff.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that gives your whole body its shape and lets you stand up?
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: It gives your body its shape.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: It protects your vital organs from getting injured.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that faces up when someone gives you a high five and touch it!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: Think about this: You rub these together to feel warm.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: The palms of your hands do not grow any hair.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to clap and hold our toys?
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Hint: You wave these to say hello.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Hands are incredibly complex and allow you to grasp small tools.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that covers your whole body, from head to toe and touch it!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Think about this: Sunscreen protects this part from the sun.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Your skin is the largest organ of your entire body.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that protects your knee joint when you kneel down?
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: It protects your knee when you kneel down.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: Babies are born without hard kneecaps; they develop later.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that a dentist checks along with your teeth?
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: They are soft and pink, inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: They protect the roots of your teeth from bacteria.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that you can feel move under your skin when you shrug?
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: It is on your upper back, below your shoulder.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: It provides a wide surface for many muscles to attach to.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that works hard all day and even while you sleep at night!
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: Hint: You use it to solve puzzles and learn new things.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: It generates enough electricity to power a small lightbulb.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found inside your chest, about the size of your own fist!
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Hint: It beats faster when you run and play.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: It pumps blood through miles of blood vessels in your body.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that rumbles loudly when you are hungry and touch it!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: Think about this: It is below your chest, above your legs.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Strong stomach acid breaks down food into nutrients.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found running from your neck all the way down to your hips!
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: Hint: It goes from your neck down to your hips.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: It is made of 33 interlocking bones called vertebrae.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you feel gently move when you swallow a sip of water -- it is also the one that lets your food travel down to your tummy when you swallow!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is inside your neck!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: It contains your vocal cords which allow you to make sounds.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you keep clean and fresh with soap in the bath -- it is also the one found right under your shoulder, where your arm meets your body!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are right under your arms!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: They are a common tickle spot because of sensitive nerve endings.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found underneath your muscles and skin, giving your body its shape!
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: Hint: They are underneath your muscles and skin.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: Babies are actually born with more bones than adults.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you might gently tap on a door to knock -- it is also the one that forms small bumps you can see when you make a tight fist!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You see these bumps when you make a fist!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: The cracking sound knuckles make is just a gas bubble popping.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you twist gently when you wiggle your foot in a circle. It is also the one found between your foot and your leg!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: They are found where your foot meets your leg!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: It has to support the force of your entire body when running.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to chew crunchy apples?
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to bite and chew your food.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Your teeth have roots that anchor deep into your jawbone.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to smell fresh cookies baking?
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Hint: It is found between your eyes and your mouth.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Mucus in your nose traps dust and germs.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that carries your backpack full of books. It is also the one you lie down on to look up at the clouds!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: It is the part of you facing away from a mirror!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: The back protects your spine and supports your torso.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you tap gently when you try to remember something. It is also the one that gets covered by a warm winter hat!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: It is the flat part above your eyebrows!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Muscles in your forehead help you express surprise or confusion.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that lets you bend down low to tie your shoes. It is also the one found halfway between your hip and your ankle!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: They are the bendy part in the middle of your leg!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: It acts like a complex hinge to let you bend your leg.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to taste delicious ice cream?
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Hint: It smiles when you are happy.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: The roof of your mouth is called the palate.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to run and kick a soccer ball?
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Hint: You have two, and you stand on them.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: The arches of your feet help you spring forward.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that stops sweat from dripping into your eyes. It is also the one you scrunch down low when you feel grumpy!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: You have two, right above your eyes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: They play a huge role in how we show our emotions.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that flutters every single time you blink. It is also the one that catches tiny bits of dust before they reach your eyes!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: They flutter every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: They act like sensors to trigger a blink if something gets too close.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we use to see colorful rainbows?
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Hint: They are found above your nose.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: The human eye can distinguish millions of different colors.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part where your legs connect to the rest of your body!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You put your hands on these like a superhero.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: They bear the weight of your upper body when you stand.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that helps you push hard when you pedal a bike!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They have some of the strongest muscles in your body.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: The femur bone inside your thigh is the body's longest bone.
